meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 HTML 和时间轴搭出可渲染的视频合成项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用代码定义片段与轨道来生成或渲染视频动画。
copy.tagline_en: Build a renderable video composition with clips, tracks, and exact timing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you define clips and tracks in code to render video animations

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 按 HyperFrames 合成契约帮你写可渲染的 HTML 合成:用 data-* 属性声明时间、注册一条暂停的 GSAP 时间线、媒体播放由框架托管,再用 npx hyperframes check 校验。
howto.when: 当你要写合成 HTML,或涉及 data-* 时间属性、class="clip"、轨道等结构问题时接管;原文要求写合成 HTML 前先读它。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 搭一个最小可渲染的合成骨架
say.note: 从最小骨架起步再扩展

say.text: 跑 npx hyperframes check 看看这个合成哪里报错
say.note: 会列出 lint 等检查结果

say.text: 给这个合成加一个子合成,并把宿主 id 接好
say.note: 会按宿主 id 约定接线

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes renderable HyperFrames HTML compositions: timing declared with data-* attributes, one paused GSAP timeline per composition, media playback owned by the framework, then validated with npx hyperframes check.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you write composition HTML or deal with data-* timing attributes, class="clip", tracks and similar structure; the skill says to read it before writing composition HTML.
